items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: So I had occasion to record some bop music with Thelonius Monk... Chano was the connection, huh? Yeah.

ctx.x: Yes, I had to, because if I listened to him I wouldn't know where I was, you know. I had to resort to everything. I bought Chano Pozo out of cocaine and marijuana, and I'd go to the liquor store and buy me a fifth of VO and a fifth of Seagram's VO, and a fifth of vodka, trying to neutralize the cocaine. And I couldn't get drunk, I couldn't get loaded or anything else, but I was resorting to this to try to get way spaced out to keep up with Monk, and I couldn't catch him. So --

Yeah. So I had occasion to record some bop music with Thelonius Monk, which two of them I remember. One was "Mysterioso", and the other one was "Epistrophy". And we had a vocal on it. He yood Pancho did a vocal on one of them. I forget what it was. But it was out of his key and Monk made him sing it anyway. And Pancho's throat was sore for a week.
